dec.n: Malawi African Association and others v. Mauritania
dec.ct: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
dec.pe: In 1989–1991 tens of thousands of black Mauritanians were driven into Senegal and Mali and their papers destroyed. The African Commission found grave violations and asked Mauritania to let them return.
dec.pi: Pada 1989–1991 puluhan ribu warga Mauritania kulit hitam diusir ke Senegal dan Mali dan dokumen mereka dihancurkan. Komisi Afrika menemukan pelanggaran berat dan meminta Mauritania mengizinkan mereka pulang.

dec.n: MRG and SOS-Esclaves (Said and Yarg Ould Salem) v. Mauritania
dec.ct: African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child
dec.pe: Two brothers were made to herd animals and work without pay from childhood. A court gave the man responsible a light sentence. The African children’s rights committee said Mauritania failed them.
dec.pi: Dua bersaudara dipaksa menggembala ternak dan bekerja tanpa upah sejak kecil. Pengadilan menjatuhkan hukuman ringan kepada pelakunya. Komite hak anak Afrika menyatakan Mauritania gagal melindungi mereka.
